description: This is a test file for the FeignParts utility class in the Fineract client, containing unit tests for media type determination, filename extraction from HTTP responses, and content type probing based on files.

classes.name: FeignPartsTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of the FeignParts utility methods related to media types, filename extraction, and content type detection.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForJpeg
methods.description: Verifies that JPEG file extensions are correctly mapped to 'image/jpeg' media type.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForJpegUppercase
methods.description: Verifies case-insensitive mapping of 'JPEG' extension to 'image/jpeg'.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForPng
methods.description: Checks if PNG extension maps correctly to 'image/png'.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForPdf
methods.description: Checks if PDF extension maps correctly to 'application/pdf'.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForDocx
methods.description: Verifies DOCX extension mapping to the correct MIME type.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForDoc
methods.description: Verifies DOC extension mapping to Word MIME type.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForXlsx
methods.description: Verifies XLSX extension maps to the correct spreadsheet MIME type.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForXls
methods.description: Verifies XLS extension maps to the correct spreadsheet MIME type.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForTiff
methods.description: Checks TIFF image extension mapping.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForGif
methods.description: Checks GIF image extension mapping.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForOdt
methods.description: Checks ODT document extension mapping.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForOds
methods.description: Checks ODS spreadsheet extension mapping.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForTxt
methods.description: Checks TXT text file extension mapping.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForUnknownExtension
methods.description: Ensures unknown extensions default to 'application/octet-stream'.

methods.name: testMediaTypeCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Validates case-insensitive media type detection.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForNullFilename
methods.description: Checks behavior when filename is null.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForFilenameWithoutExtension
methods.description: Checks behavior for filenames without extensions.

methods.name: testFileNameExtractionFromContentDisposition
methods.description: Extracts filename from Content-Disposition header with standard format.

methods.name: testFileNameExtractionWithComplexFilename
methods.description: Extracts filename with special characters and hyphens.

methods.name: testFileNameWithoutContentDisposition
methods.description: Ensures empty Optional when no Content-Disposition header.

methods.name: testFileNameWithNullHeaders
methods.description: Handles null headers gracefully.

methods.name: testFileNameWithEmptyContentDisposition
methods.description: Handles empty Content-Disposition headers.

methods.name: testFileNameWithInvalidContentDisposition
methods.description: Handles invalid Content-Disposition formats.

methods.name: testProbeContentTypeForJpegFile
methods.description: Uses actual file to verify content type detection for JPEG files.

methods.name: testProbeContentTypeForPdfFile
methods.description: Uses actual file to verify content type detection for PDF files.

methods.name: testProbeContentTypeFallsBackToMediaType
methods.description: Checks fallback behavior when content type cannot be determined.

methods.name: testProbeContentTypeForUnknownFile
methods.description: Verifies behavior for unknown file types.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForAllSupportedImageFormats
methods.description: Tests all common image formats.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForAllSupportedDocumentFormats
methods.description: Tests document formats including PDF, Word, and ODT.

methods.name: testMediaTypeForAllSupportedSpreadsheetFormats
methods.description: Tests spreadsheet formats including XLS, XLSX, and ODS.
